title: People Ops Recruiting Coordinator Daily Scratchpad
content:
Morning brain-dump / checklist - Maya (recruiting coord)

Today goals:
- Close scheduling for SDE-1 (internal req RI-2345) - need final avail from hiring manager (Evan) by 11:00am
- Follow up with 4 candidates (see list below) and send calendar invites with prep docs
- Confirm panel for PM loop tomorrow, collect panelist bios + interview rubrics
- Send offer pre-approve papers to Priya for comp approval (urgent)

Top of inbox (quick):
- Candidate: Jordan Lee - hasn't confirmed 2pm slot; email follow-up + call at 10:30 if no reply
- Candidate: Sofia Alvarez - completed take-home, schedule debrief w/ hiring manager (Evan) this week
- Candidate: Ahmed Khan - reschedule due to timezone conflict, propose Mon/Tue next week (PST window)
- Candidate: Priya Patel - available for onsites on 3/11-3/13, needs travel checklist link

Interview scheduling notes:
- SDE-1 onsite (virtual): block 9:30-1:00 for panel. Need to send pre-interview rubric and test instructions. Attach: interview-guide-2026.pdf (confluence link above)
- PM loop: confirm PM hiring manager can join 2:00-4:00 tomorrow. If not, fallback to Fri afternoon.
- Ask SRE panel for backup interviewer (TBD) in case of last-minute swap

Follow-ups / messages to send today:
- Slack -> #hiring-sde: quick note w/ updated candidate grid + ask for urgent avail (Evan, Priya)
- Email -> Jordan Lee: polite nudge w/ two alternative times + calendar placeholders
- Email -> Sofia Alvarez: thanks + request for 20-min debrief availability
- Email -> Priya Patel: travel checklist + reimbursement policy link

Offer / comp pipeline:
- Candidate: Mei Chen - verbal offer accepted yesterday. Need to:
  - upload offer doc to Greenhouse
  - initiate background check (vendor: Checkr)
  - send onboarding checklist (IT + HR forms) - Priya to confirm start date
- Blocker: comp approval pending from People Ops (Priya) for one senior IC; pinged at 9:05am, follow-up 11:30am if not approved

Admin / trackers:
- Update hiring tracker spreadsheet (sheet link in sidebar) after each calendar confirm
- Mark candidates who need relocation assistance in column H; Mei Chen + Priya Patel flagged
- Daily metrics to update by EOD: #screens, #onsites, #offers sent

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Create a short standardized "what to expect" email for onsite candidates (1-page) - draft after lunch
- Check with SRE ops about virtual whiteboard access for coding interviews (Zoom + Miro)
- Reminder: sync with People Ops lead weekly 1:1 on Fridays - prep list of recurring scheduling pain points

Timeblocking (rough):
- 9:00-9:30: inbox triage + Slack pings
- 9:30-11:00: outreach and follow-ups (Jordan, Sofia, Ahmed)
- 11:00-12:00: schedule panel invites + collect bios
- 12:00-12:30: lunch
- 12:30-3:30: offer paperwork + Greenhouse updates + background check kicks
- 3:30-4:30: create "what to expect" candidate email draft
- 4:30-5:00: update trackers, prepare EOD summary to People Ops

Open questions / blockers:
- Hiring manager availability for SDE-1 - Evan to confirm by 11:00
- Comp approval delay for senior IC - Priya follow-up
- Confirmation of vendor pricing for expedited background checks if candidate requests faster turnaround

Quick scratch notes (short-hand):
- bring sample rubric to send with invites
- doc templates: offer, travel, equipment request (update templates repo)
- check timezone conversions (Ahmed TZ math: PST -> CET)

EOD deliverables:
- All invites sent for confirmed times
- Greenhouse updated (status + offer docs)
- 10-min summary to People Ops Slack w/ blockers and wins

----
Other references:
- Interview guide: CONFLUENCE-1234-interview-guide
- Job posting: https://greenhouse.example.com/jobs/RI-2345
- Slack threads: #hiring-sde, #people-ops

Tiny wins to celebrate:
- Mei Chen verbal accepted (yay) - get paperwork flowing
- Panelist Sam agreed to cover emergency swap next week

End of scratchpad.
